title: Doesn't get very warm
text: Doesn't get very warm. I was not impressed. Hardly got warm at all even on the highest setting and underneath my comforter on my bed. Returned.

product_metadata.title: Kozyus Heated Blanket Electric Throw, Electric Blanket with 3 Heat Settings and Extra Long 13-Foot Power Cord, Reversible Soft Flannel and Sherpa Full Body Heating Blanket for Warmth, 50" x 60", Beige
features: CHASE AWAY CHILLS under the cosy comfort of our reversible electric blanket throw. This warming blanket combines the luxurious softness of flannel and Sherpa facings with the full-body warmth of a heat blanket for couch and bed

LARGE 50” X 60” SIZE is perfect for lounging or napping on the sofa, and the extra-long 13-foot power cord allows you to get up and move about without uncovering. Conquer the cold without cranking-up the thermostat

3 HEAT SETTINGS make this the perfect all-season electric throw blanket. A simple 1-button LED controller is a breeze to use, and integrated wires provide fast and even heat distribution without uncomfortable hot spots

DETACHABLE POWER CORD makes our electric heated blanket machine-washable for easy care. With tasteful gift packaging, it makes a thoughtful and impressive Christmas gift or birthday gift for women and men

ETL SAFETY CERTIFICATION offers you the peace of mind that your heated throw blanket has undergone stringent quality control inspections. A 4-hour auto-shut-off feature conserves energy and provides over-heat protection

details.Product Care Instructions: Do Not Plug Into the Wall Outlet Until You Have Connected the Controller Cord to the Blanket to Make Sure It Works Properly.
